system.description:
IMPACT ABSORPTION

DEFENCE FOCUS

Action R

Trigger a targeted physical attack damages you

You brace and allow your spirit to absorb the impact. Your Base DR increases by 1 against the triggering attack.

Use (before the damage is applied): spends your reaction in combat and this ability's Focus use (Refocus restores it), and raises your Base DR by 1 until the end of the current turn — delete the effect once the triggering attack has resolved if the turn goes on. TRG Prime cannot yet offer a reaction before damage (core dependency D8), so you press it.
